coverage.notes: SEL: OSPI's SEL Standards and Benchmarks (6 standards, 17 benchmarks) adopted January 2020, with indicators by grade band. Portrait of a Graduate: Washington calls it the 'Profile of a Graduate' - a guiding vision developed by the Mastery-based Learning Work Group (directed by SSB 5249, 2021) and published by the State Board of Education. The SBE page describes it as a guiding vision to inform policy, not a graduation requirement. Its component list is in a graphic that was NOT read, so no Profile items are loaded yet. Reviewer: confirm 'statewide' fits the Profile's actual status.

frameworks.name: Washington Social Emotional Learning Standards, Benchmarks and Indicators
frameworks.issuingBody: Office of Superintendent of Public Instruction (OSPI)
frameworks.notes: Read from OSPI's long-form PDF (ospi.k12.wa.us/sites/default/files/2023-08/selstandardsbenchmarksindicatorslongform_0.pdf). Six standards (Self-Awareness, Self-Management, Self-Efficacy, Social Awareness, Social Management, Social Engagement) and 17 benchmarks; indicators by grade band (K-3, 4-5, 6-8, 9+). Items are the 17 benchmarks; titles are short paraphrases. Washington's standards do not map one-to-one onto CASEL, so CASEL tags are set only where the standard's name matches (1, 2A/2B, 4); the rest are blank on purpose.

items.title: Awareness of one's own emotions and their influence on behavior
items.summary: Standard 1, Self-Awareness: understand one's emotions and how they affect behavior.

items.title: Awareness of personal and collective identity
items.summary: Standard 1, Self-Awareness: strengths, areas for growth, aspirations, and cultural and linguistic assets.

items.title: Awareness of external influences and supports
items.summary: Standard 1, Self-Awareness: how culture, family, school and community resources and supports shape the individual.

items.title: Manage emotions, thoughts, impulses and stress
items.summary: Standard 2, Self-Management: skills to manage emotions, thoughts, impulses and stress constructively.

items.title: Responsible decision-making and problem-solving
items.summary: Standard 2, Self-Management: make responsible decisions and solve problems.

items.title: Set, monitor, adapt, persevere, achieve and evaluate goals
items.summary: Standard 3, Self-Efficacy: skills to work through goals from setting to evaluating.

items.title: Problem-solving to engage responsibly in varied situations
items.summary: Standard 3, Self-Efficacy: use problem-solving skills to engage responsibly.

items.title: Speak up for personal rights and advocacy
items.summary: Standard 3, Self-Efficacy: awareness of and ability to speak on behalf of personal rights.

items.title: Awareness of others' emotions, perspectives and identities
items.summary: Standard 4, Social Awareness: awareness of others' emotions, perspectives, cultures, languages, histories, identities and abilities.

items.title: Awareness and respect for similarities and differences
items.summary: Standard 4, Social Awareness: respect for similarities and differences among community, cultural and social groups.

items.title: Understanding variation within and across cultures
items.summary: Standard 4, Social Awareness: understand the variation within and across cultures.

items.title: Communication and social skills for effective interaction
items.summary: Standard 5, Social Management: use communication and social skills to interact effectively.

items.title: Identify and resolve interpersonal conflicts constructively
items.summary: Standard 5, Social Management: take steps to resolve conflicts constructively.

items.title: Respectful, healthy relationships across differences
items.summary: Standard 5, Social Management: build respectful relationships with people of diverse perspectives, cultures, languages, histories, identities and abilities.

items.title: Sense of school and community responsibility
items.summary: Standard 6, Social Engagement: a sense of responsibility to school and community.

items.title: Work with others to set and achieve goals
items.summary: Standard 6, Social Engagement: collaborate to set, monitor, adapt, achieve and evaluate goals.

items.title: Contribute productively to school, workplace and community
items.summary: Standard 6, Social Engagement: contribute to the well-being of school, workplace and community.
